**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-supplier, or requirements obligation on Bluefly. Searches for "exclusive," "sole," "all of its requirements," "from any third party," and "competitor" surfaced only:

- § 5.2 / § 4.3 — exclusive-warranty disclaimer and tax-exclusive charges (unrelated to dealing exclusivity);
- §§ 5.4, 12.1 — **nonexclusive** licences granted *by IBM to us* (beneficial/neutral to our party).

Section 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively provides that "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others," preserving our right to procure hosting services from other suppliers. This satisfies the preferred position, so no narrowing or deletion is needed.
